Command Line Interface

This section documents the CLI components and commands.

Main CLI Application

The main entry point for the 5e2pdf command-line interface.

Main CLI application for 5e2pdf.

src.cli.main.show_version()[source]

Show version information.

src.cli.main.main(verbose: bool = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>)[source]

🎲 5e2pdf - Modern D&D 5e content converter

Convert structured JSON data from 5e.tools into professional LaTeX documents that match the style of official D&D 5th edition books.

async src.cli.main.get_omnidexer() → Omnidexer[source]

Get or create the global omnidexer instance.

async src.cli.main.get_tag_resolver() → TagResolver[source]

Get or create the global tag resolver instance.

src.cli.main.legacy_mode(args: ~typing.List[str] = <typer.models.ArgumentInfo object>)[source]

🔄 Legacy Mode - Run commands with backwards compatibility

Execute legacy json2tex.py commands using the modern architecture. Maintains full compatibility with existing scripts and workflows.

Examples

5e2pdf legacy –adventure –no-images data.json > output.tex 5e2pdf legacy –book –with-images book.json > book.tex

src.cli.main.serve_api(host: str = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, port: int = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, reload: bool = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>)[source]

🚀 API Server - Start REST API server (Future Feature)

Launch a web API for converting D&D content remotely.

src.cli.main.quick_convert(input_file: ~pathlib.Path = <typer.models.ArgumentInfo object>, output_file: ~pathlib.Path | None = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, content_type: str = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, with_images: bool = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, compile_pdf: bool = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>)[source]

⚡ Quick Convert - Fast single-file conversion

Convert a single JSON file to LaTeX with minimal configuration. Perfect for quick conversions and testing.

Convert command for 5e2pdf CLI.

📖 Convert adventure JSON to LaTeX

Converts a D&D adventure from 5e.tools JSON format into a beautifully formatted LaTeX document matching official book styling.

src.cli.commands.convert.convert_book(input_file: ~pathlib.Path = <typer.models.ArgumentInfo object>, output_file: ~pathlib.Path | None = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, title: str | None = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, with_images: bool = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, with_index: bool = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, compile_pdf: bool = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>)[source]

📚 Convert book JSON to LaTeX

Converts a D&D sourcebook from 5e.tools JSON format into a beautifully formatted LaTeX document matching official book styling.

src.cli.commands.convert.convert_supplement(input_file: ~pathlib.Path = <typer.models.ArgumentInfo object>, output_file: ~pathlib.Path | None = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, title: str | None = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, content_types: ~typing.List[str] = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, with_images: bool = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, compile_pdf: bool = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>)[source]

📄 Convert supplement JSON to LaTeX

Converts various D&D content (spells, creatures, items) from 5e.tools JSON format into a formatted supplement document.

List Commands

Commands for listing and discovering available content.

List command for 5e2pdf CLI.

src.cli.commands.list_content.list_files(directory: ~pathlib.Path | None = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, pattern: str = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>)[source]

📁 List available JSON files

Shows all JSON files available for conversion in the specified directory or default data directories.

src.cli.commands.list_content.list_content(content_type: str | None = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, source: str | None = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, limit: int = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, search: str | None = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>)[source]

📋 List loaded content items

Shows content that has been loaded into the omnidexer system. Useful for finding specific spells, creatures, items, etc.

src.cli.commands.list_content.list_sources()[source]

📚 List available source books

Shows all source books that have content loaded in the system.

Commands for showing detailed information about content.

Info command for 5e2pdf CLI.

src.cli.commands.info.show_content_info(name: str = <typer.models.ArgumentInfo object>, content_type: str | None = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>, source: str | None = <typer.models.OptionInfo object>)[source]

🔍 Show detailed information about a specific content item

Displays comprehensive details about spells, creatures, items, etc. including all attributes and formatted descriptions.

src.cli.commands.info.show_file_info(file_path: str = <typer.models.ArgumentInfo object>)[source]

📄 Show information about a JSON file

Analyzes a JSON file and shows what content it contains, structure, and statistics.

Stats Commands

Commands for showing statistics and analytics.

Stats command for 5e2pdf CLI.

src.cli.commands.stats.show_overview()[source]

📊 Show overall content statistics

Displays a comprehensive overview of all loaded content including counts by type, source, and other metrics.

src.cli.commands.stats.show_content_stats(content_type: str = <typer.models.ArgumentInfo object>)[source]

🔍 Show detailed statistics for a specific content type

Provides in-depth analysis of spells, creatures, items, etc. including breakdowns by various attributes.

src.cli.commands.stats.show_source_stats()[source]

📚 Show statistics by source book

Displays detailed breakdown of content by source book, showing what each book contributes to the collection.

Legacy Compatibility

Backwards compatibility layer for existing json2tex workflows.

Backwards compatibility layer for legacy json2tex.py commands.

class src.cli.compat.LegacyCompatLayer[source]

Bases: object

Provides backwards compatibility with the original json2tex.py script.

This class parses legacy command line arguments and executes them using the modern architecture, maintaining full compatibility with existing scripts and workflows.

__init__()[source]

Parameters:

args – Command line arguments in legacy format

Returns:

Generated LaTeX content as string

src.cli.compat.create_legacy_wrapper()[source]

Create a legacy wrapper script for backwards compatibility.

This creates a json2tex.py script that calls the modern CLI in legacy mode, maintaining complete backwards compatibility.
